title: Noor and the Ghost
premise: Ulyana Thornbury, a deniable fixer for an embassy that exists only in encrypted memos, is haunted by a botched extraction that cost a colleague her life. When Flight 447's records vanish mid-air, he traces the anomaly to Noor Haddad, a defector carrying proof that the 'ghost flight' was a market-manipulation operation run by his own agency. Ordered to extract Noor before Frankfurt opens, Ulyana realizes she is bait designed to flush out and destroy him. Choosing love over duty, he burns his cover, exposes the operation at dawn, and escapes with Noor into an unrecorded life.
about_author: Quentin Vane is the pen name of a former intelligence-adjacent consultant who writes thrillers from a coastal town he refuses to name. His novels are known for their procedural precision and their tenderness toward people who live off the books.

chapters.title: The Unlisted Hour
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV. Sleepless in Vienna, he takes a routine errand and notices Flight 447 has no manifest, no radar trail, no passengers—yet its shadow crossed the city at 3 a.m. The emotional beat is dread: the invisible man discovering that invisibility is being used against others, and that someone knows he'll notice.

chapters.title: Noor
chapters.summary: Alternating POV with Noor Haddad, hiding in a safehouse with a drive of impossible data. Their first meeting is transactional, then human—she recognizes his insomnia as grief. Rising tension: his agency orders the extraction for 5:40 a.m., before Frankfurt opens, while Noor suspects the timing itself is a trap.

chapters.title: Before the Bell
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV, real-time through the pre-dawn streets. Extraction goes wrong: ambush confirms Noor is bait, and the handler who ordered it is the voice from his worst memory—the incident. Climax: with markets seconds from opening, Ulyana transmits Noor's evidence publicly, torching his own cover to blind the hunters.

chapters.title: Off the Books
chapters.summary: Noor's POV. In a border town that appears on no maps they trust, they wait for pursuit that doesn't come. The agency disavows them; the ghost flight becomes a footnote. Resolution beat: belonging found not in any registry but in each other—two erased people writing themselves into existence, one quiet morning at a time.
